headline: South Korea's Rural Development Administration says its agriculture LLM is in an internal pilot
summary: South Korea’s Rural Development Administration (RDA) said on 12 November 2026 that it had completed an agriculture and life-sciences language model using government-provided compute and had been piloting it inside the agency since October. RDA reports training on roughly 35,000 agriculture and life-sciences papers and reports and says the model returns answers with supporting sources. The agency has begun a separate research-collaboration AI project targeting 2028, with planned support for hypothesis generation, analysis and interpretation. These are agency-reported milestones and plans; the release provides no benchmark, independent evaluation, or measured research-productivity result.
